answer: Time-locked capability vesting resists sybils: joining grants only a watcher's role, and each real privilege (grading, voting, high-value transfer) unlocks only after a fixed count of epochs of unbroken standing, any TTL lapse resetting the clock to zero. Weight is not the lever; a hard calendar gate is. A swarm minted to swing one vote reaches the summit of its plume and finds every capability still locked, since elapsed epochs cannot be compressed. Keeping a garden of fakes across the whole vesting window is a prepaid cost, forfeited the moment standing lapses.
